docs.desc: VOTING RESULTS OF WEBULL CORPORATION'S 2026 GENERAL MEETING OF SHAREHOLDERS
SIXTH AMENDED AND RESTATED MEMORANDUM AND ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION OF WEBULL CORP

desk.headline: Latest results: record Q2 revenue up 51% to $198.8m and a $24.3m profit (reported 19 Aug); no guidance; Q3 due 19 Nov
results: The 12 November filing gives the results of the 30 Oct shareholder meeting, not earnings: new articles of association (95.8% in favour) and a 2026 employee share purchase plan with 5m shares (99.9% in favour). Q3 results are due on 19 Nov.
In Q2 (reported 19 Aug) revenue rose 51% to a record $198.8m as trading revenue jumped 66% after US day-trading limits were scrapped on 4 June.
Webull swung to a $24.3m profit ($0.04 a share) from a loss; adjusted net income was $43.2m.
Customer assets rose 79% to $28.5bn; daily trades rose 62% to 1.6m and stock trading volume 73% to $279bn.
Webull launched in Spain, Argentina and Colombia and agreed to buy Pi Securities in Thailand; it bought back 1.8m shares at an average $6.03.

points: Management called the end of the day-trader rule the key event of the quarter and does not expect volumes to fall back to earlier levels.
Options trading held up in July and August was running ahead of July.
Marketing spend should stay between Q1 and Q2 levels for the rest of 2026; some promotions were cut.
Prediction markets brought in about $5–6m, up 71% on Q1; crypto was just over 1% of revenue.

reports.title: Webull Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Record revenue up 39% to $218.7m, beat; GAAP EPS $0.06 vs $0.07 a year ago; no financial guidance
results: Revenue rose 39% to a record $218.7m; trading-related revenue jumped 53% to $164.7m as options contracts traded rose 79% to 263m.
Adjusted operating profit nearly doubled to $70.0m, while adjusted costs rose 24% to $148.8m, mostly trading-linked brokerage fees.
Net income fell to $31.2m from $36.9m because of higher tax, share-based pay and a $9.2m non-cash charge tied to the Pi Securities deal; diluted EPS was $0.06 versus $0.07.
Customer assets grew 53% to $32.4bn, helped by about $3bn from Pi Securities in Thailand; funded accounts rose 5% to 5.18m.
Margin loan balances passed $1bn for the first time; no shares were bought back in the quarter.

guidance.summary: Webull gives no formal financial guidance. On the call it said marketing should stay within 20–30% of revenue in 2026, rise modestly in Q4 and fall as a share of revenue in 2027.

points: Management credited the June change to the pattern day-trader rule: for affected traders, options volume more than doubled and stock trading value roughly tripled.
Crypto perpetual futures went live during the call, and crypto contracts have overtaken sports as the biggest source of prediction-market revenue.
October set a monthly record for options trading; management said spells of high volatility tend to lift volumes for a few months.
Capital priorities are balance-sheet strength first, then acquisitions, then buybacks; buybacks were paused during an October blackout.
Management said a US House committee report on Webull raised no new issues and that US customer data and assets are held in the US.
call.source: Earnings call transcript: Webull beats Q3 2026 estimates as active trading lifts results — Investing.com, 20 Nov 2026; Seeking Alpha, 19 Nov 2026

watch: Whether trading volumes stay high after the day-trader rule boost and October's record.
Integration savings from Pi Securities, expected in the first half of 2027.
Regulatory follow-up to the US House committee report.
